steps.name: Anita
steps.text: That should take care of it, I think? We should have enough for me, Grandma, and Bench...

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Oh, and the singer too. She will come back, right? We can't let her go hungry.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: We still have... some. We can put the rest in the box.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Uh, Uncle Fireplace, you wanted some? O-Okay, I can give you some first.

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Whoa, I think that's seaweed on your arm! Let me have it! I'll make the... uh... seaweed alcohol that the singer taught me to make!

steps.name: Anita
steps.text: Huh? Where did Bench go? I only took my eyes off for a moment.

steps.name: Young Inhabitant
steps.text: (Makes children noises)

a.text: A red-clad figure appears before him.

steps.name: Young Inhabitant
steps.text: Ah... Songs... Ahhh...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Stop grabbing...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This is yours.

steps.name: Young Inhabitant
steps.text: Whaa...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Stop chewing it... It's not something you can eat.

steps.name: Young Inhabitant
steps.text: Woodframe... Woodframe...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Don't call her...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Yeah, give her my harp, will you?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Tell her... No, I guess you can't talk.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This isn't a goodbye.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'll go ask a question. Then, I'll tell her myself.

a.text: Skadi looks at the chapel overlooking the town. She knows how to get to her destination.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: High Inquisitor, are we planting explosives at the hill right now?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: That is correct.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: On another note, I saw someone entering the chapel.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: She looks very much like that... outsider we met before.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: So, High Inquisitor, who is she?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: An Ægir.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I heard she fought the Sea Terrors.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I'm surprised there are others who not only know about these monsters... but specialize in fighting them as well...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: If we blow up the chapel... Will she be affected?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: If we don't strike the evil at its root, even destroying this place won't accomplish anything.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Is that so? So we still have to find out who caused this phenomenon... And you don't know who it is yourself, High Inquisitor?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: You may not ask anything that has nothing to do with the mission.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Understood...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Also, while I'm aware you don't mind, I have to say this nonetheless... The load-bearing structure of this block probably won't withstand the intensity of the explosion.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: The southern half of the city may crumble any moment, and the inhabitants here still don't know anything about this.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Proceed.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I want to evacuate the inhabitants.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I mean, to you, they may seem peculiar and problematic...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: ...and also things that need to be cleansed.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Inquisitor!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Uhh...!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Tell me! What is your responsibility?!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: 'For Iberia's prosperity, for Iberia's defense, and for Iberia's orderliness and integrity, I shall raise my sword and my light!'

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: In that case, you must lay down your judgment for these men!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: You want me to... lay down judgment? To sentence them to death?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: High Inquisitor, when was the last time you listened to a song? Your records have all gone bad, haven't they? Your player has been gathering dust for a long time too.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I heard that song. I heard the song the Ægir was singing for these people.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: That's the kind of song that Iberia should have had.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Before we kill them, I want to know the truth. Just like you were trying to find who is behind this.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Perhaps they will still mutate, but when that time comes, I will cleanse them myself, but I would like to evacuate them right now.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: High Inquisitor, if I have your permission, I will evacuate everyone right away!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Is that your decision?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I don't know!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Irene, you are not just laying down decisions for those you see in front of you. Your decisions affect much more!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: By sentencing the monsters to live, you also sentence the citizens to die!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I understand! I've already made decisions like this one countless of times!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Your judgment can mitigate disasters or portend ill omens! You may kill hundreds merely to save one!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I understand that, Sir!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What's at stake behind this deal, the clashes between morals and scriptures... I understand it all!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: That isn't what I'm asking you.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: What I'm asking you, Irene, is if you can truly bear this responsibility.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: If you bring them great pain, then you too must bear this pain as well, and it will be far graver than the sins you inflict on others combined.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Do you have the courage? Will your beliefs remain steadfast when your heart is tormented? If you fail, are you certain you can stay unflinching when you witness the outcome of your decision?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I can take it... and I won't waver.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: That's what I've been doing all along ever since I joined the Inquisition. I can do it. If what I do proves to be wrong, then let me receive the proper punishment. This is something I must do.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: High Inquisitor! I—

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: This will do. Do your duty, Inquisitor.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: —Yes, High Inquisitor! I will evacuate the local inhabitants right away!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Also... The explosives left in the cabinet should be enough to level the whole of Sal Viento.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: So...

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: If it comes to it, I will override your judgment.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I'll get going now.

a.text: Irene dashes off like the wind.
The High Inquisitor stands tall, unmoving, just like the reefs next to the sea.

It is only when the Inquisitors have doubts in their hearts that they have the chance to seek out the answer. However, for a young woman who has experienced little of the world's ugly side or its mirages...
She needs to be hammered and tempered. She needs to fail, to crumble.
She must first suffer. She must first abandon her unrealistic aspirations before she can truly be indomitable.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Who is it?
Hello, High Inquisitor.

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Oh, look who's here?

steps.name: Bishop
steps.text: Welcome, wandering singer.
